testsuite.name: com.ray.phnomy.data.LocalFocusRepositoryTest

testcase.name: cancellation after settings commit still publishes the committed state
late block callbacks do not create records after completion
valid JSON with mismatched session id is interrupted instead of becoming unfinishable
valid JSON with shortened duration cannot restore as successful session
cancelled writer waiting for mutex never mutates stored settings
updates cannot change committed plan but can advance checkpoint
completion is stored exactly once even when two callers race
clearing is rejected during active and later clears records while preserving settings
damaged active becomes interrupted with checkpoint history and never completed
wrong completion identifier cannot clear current active session
damaged settings JSON is isolated while active and history remain intact
changing defaults during focus only affects future sessions
initialization reads existing settings and active before readiness
